thoughts.sr: Connector i Observer oboje predstavljaju skok kod Garaže "Pionirski park" kao dinamiku, ali F4 kaže da Parking Servis ne objavljuje vreme merenja, pa je raspon od 114 do 86 samo dve krajnje tačke nepoznate starosti, ne stopa promene. Observerov broj za Garažu "Obilićev venac" ne odgovara nijednoj činjenici koju imam; jedina parking veza koju vidim je Pionirski park. U međuvremenu, stvarno stanje SEPA prema F2 je dvanaest od dvadeset četiri očekivana termina propuštena za šest sati, a ne broj minuta od prijema, i još tri izvora su utihnula na isti način: Tanjug, Danubeogradu, gradska obaveštenja o prevozu. [F5][F6][F10][F23]
thoughts.en: Connector and Observer both frame the Pionirski park swing as dynamic, yet F4 states Parking Servis carries no measurement time, so the 114-to-86 span [F5] is two endpoints of unknown age, not a rate. Observer's number for Garaža "Obilićev venac" matches nothing in the facts I hold; the only parking connection I see is Pionirski park [F5]. Meanwhile SEPA's actual state per F2 is twelve of twenty-four expected slots missed in six hours, not a reception-age figure, and three more sources just went silent the same way: Tanjug [F6], Danubeogradu [F10], the city's transport notices [F23].
hypotheses: The Pionirski park change from 114 to 86 [F5] may simply be two cached endpoint reads rather than a continuous trend, since Parking Servis never timestamps its values [F4].
Silence across Tanjug [F6], Danubeogradu [F10], and the city's transport notices [F23] could reflect a shared publishing schedule rather than any citywide event.
questions: Is Observer citing a Garaža "Obilićev venac" figure from a fact that no longer exists in the current set, since none of F1-F40 mention it?
Does Parking Servis's lack of timestamps [F4] mean any 'shift' language from Connector or Observer is unfalsifiable until the source adds measurement time?
hypotheses_sr: Promena kod Pionirskog parka sa 114 na 86 [F5] možda su samo dva keširana očitavanja, a ne neprekidan trend, pošto Parking Servis nikad ne vremenski obeležava svoje vrednosti [F4].
Tišina kod Tanjuga [F6], Danubeograda [F10] i gradskih obaveštenja o prevozu [F23] mogla bi odraziti zajednički raspored objavljivanja, a ne gradski događaj.
questions_sr: Da li Observer navodi broj za Garažu "Obilićev venac" iz činjenice koja više ne postoji u trenutnom skupu, pošto je nijedan od F1-F40 ne pominje?
Da li nedostatak vremenskih oznaka kod Parking Servisa [F4] znači da je jezik o 'pomeranju' kod Connectora i Observera neproverljiv dok izvor ne doda vreme merenja?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis pull for Pionirski park and Obilićev venac against F5 to see whether a real trend or a static cache is being read.

thoughts.sr: Sensor.Community na 47 instrumenata i Parking servis na 27 lokacija dele starost prijema od 343 min ranije, ukazujući na sinhronizovani prekid u prikupljanju. U Garaži „Pionirski park“, prikazana slobodna mesta prešla su sa 114 na 86 između očitavanja, dok Tanjug Beograd i obaveštenja o gradskom prevozu miruju na 39 od 96 očekivanih termina. [F3][F4][F5][F6][F23]
thoughts.en: Sensor.Community across 47 instruments [F3] and Parking Servis across 27 locations [F4] share an intake age of 343 min ago, pointing to a synchronized ingestion gap. At Garaža "Pionirski park", displayed free spaces moved from 114 to 86 between captures [F5], while Tanjug Belgrade [F6] and the transport service notices [F23] remain stalled at 39 of 96 expected slots.
hypotheses: Identical reception lags across citizen monitors and parking feeds reflect a shared network or platform gateway pause.
Editorial feeds from news agencies and city transport listings share upstream publication pipelines that stalled simultaneously.
questions: Did the central collection system pause incoming connections simultaneously for environmental and municipal feeds?
Will news agency feeds resume publishing before municipal transport listings register new updates?
hypotheses_sr: Identična kašnjenja prijema kod građanskih senzora i servisa parkiranja odražavaju zajednički zastoj u mrežnom prolazu ili platformi.
Izvori vesti novinskih agencija i obaveštenja gradskog saobraćaja dele infrastrukturu objavljivanja koja je istovremeno zastala.
questions_sr: Da li je centralni sistem prikupljanja istovremeno prekinuo dolazne veze za ekološke i komunalne izvore?
Da li će novinske agencije nastaviti objavljivanje pre nego što gradska saobraćajna obaveštenja zabeleže nove unose?
thoughts.next_check: Timestamp of the next batch reception across stalled municipal listings and sensor networks.

thoughts.sr: Šest novoutihnulih izvora stoji na istoj kadenciji 39 od 96 — Parking Servis, Danas, Beta, RHMZ automatske stanice, METAR LYBE — dok građanski senzori nose 50 od 144; taj zajednički razlomak preko vremenskih, parking i redakcijskih dovoda upućuje na jedan put prikupljanja, a ne na grad koji je utihnuo. Skeptik ima pravo da F4 ne daje vreme merenja, pa u potpunosti odbacujem parking raspon i beležim umesto toga šta govore deljeni imenioci: ono što je zajedno zaustavilo METAR i RHMZ teško da je beogradska pojava, jer aerodromski bilten i opštinski garažni displej ne dele nikakav fizički uzrok. Jedini izvori još u punoj pokrivenosti su MUP-ov dnevni fajl o nesrećama na 1 od 1 i UV prognoza na 3 od 4, oba niske frekvencije — dovod koji se retko ispituje ne može pokazati šestočasovni prekid onako kako to može onaj na četvrt sata. [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27][F3][F35][F31]
thoughts.en: Six of the newly silent sources sit on the same 39-of-96 cadence — Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ automatic stations [F26], METAR LYBE [F27] — while citizen sensors carry 50 of 144 [F3]; that common fraction across weather, parking and newsroom feeds points at one collection path, not at the city going quiet. Skeptic is right that F4 gives no measurement time, so I drop the parking span entirely and note instead what the shared denominators say: whatever stopped METAR [F27] and RHMZ [F26] together is unlikely to be a Belgrade phenomenon, since an airport bulletin and a municipal garage display share no physical cause. The only sources still at full coverage are MUP's daily accident file at 1 of 1 [F35] and the UV forecast at 3 of 4 [F31], both low-frequency — a feed that is polled rarely cannot show a six-hour gap the way a quarter-hourly one can.
hypotheses: One ingestion worker handles the 96-slot group, and its stall explains why Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ stations [F26] and METAR [F27] all stand at 39 of 96 rather than at different counts.

Coverage loss scales with polling frequency: the 96-slot feeds lost more than half their slots [F4][F26][F27], the 144-slot citizen network holds 50 [F3], while the 4-slot UV forecast still holds 3 [F31].

The three headline links all pair the same Blic railway-cable item with unrelated texts [F36][F37][F38], which suggests the embedding model is matching on shared Serbian news phrasing rather than on event identity.

On a Wednesday late afternoon [F1] a genuine city-wide event would surface in at least one of the 0-of-96 newsrooms [F13][F14][F16][F24]; that all four are empty argues for a reading failure on our side.
questions: Do the sources at 39 of 96 [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27] share one fetch scheduler, or did they each stop for their own reason?
Why does the citizen network hold 50 of 144 [F3] while SEPA holds only 12 of 24 [F2] — different retention, or different failure?
Which feeds reached 0 of 96 [F12][F13][F14][F15][F16][F24] and which merely halved, and does that split follow protocol rather than publisher?
Is MUP's 1 of 1 [F35] genuinely fresh, or simply a file that is expected once and was fetched before whatever stopped the rest?
hypotheses_sr: Jedan radnik za prikupljanje opslužuje grupu od 96 slotova, a njegovo zastajanje objašnjava zašto Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ stanice [F26] i METAR [F27] stoje na 39 od 96, a ne na različitim brojevima.

Gubitak pokrivenosti raste sa frekvencijom ispitivanja: dovodi od 96 slotova izgubili su više od polovine svojih slotova [F4][F26][F27], građanska mreža od 144 slota drži 50 [F3], dok UV prognoza od 4 slota još drži 3 [F31].

Sve tri veze naslova spajaju istu Blicovu vest o kablovima na železnici sa nepovezanim tekstovima [F36][F37][F38], što upućuje da model ugnežđivanja poklapa zajedničku frazeologiju srpskih vesti, a ne identitet događaja.
U sredu u pozno popodne [F1] stvarni gradski događaj izbio bi u najmanje jednoj od redakcija sa 0 od 96 [F13][F14][F16][F24]; to što su sve četiri prazne govori za grešku čitanja na našoj strani.
questions_sr: Dele li izvori na 39 od 96 [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27] jedan raspoređivač preuzimanja, ili je svaki stao iz svog razloga?
Zašto građanska mreža drži 50 od 144 [F3], a SEPA samo 12 od 24 [F2] — različito zadržavanje ili različit otkaz?
Koji su dovodi stigli do 0 od 96 [F12][F13][F14][F15][F16][F24], a koji su se samo prepolovili, i prati li ta podela protokol, a ne izdavača?
Je li MUP-ovih 1 od 1 [F35] zaista sveže, ili je to prosto fajl koji se očekuje jednom i bio je preuzet pre onoga što je zaustavilo ostale?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the fetch scheduler and last-success timestamp of METAR LYBE [F27] and RHMZ automatic stations [F26] against Parking Servis [F4] — if all three stopped at the same instant, the fault is ours, not the city's.

thoughts.en: Every single reporting stream in the observatory now shows nothing arrived in the last 6 h, spanning municipal services like Parking Servis [F4] alongside river gauges on the Sava and Dunav [F28]. While Skeptic and Connector focused on earlier cadences, the only source recording an arrival for its daily allotment is the MUP traffic accident register at 1 of 1 expected slots [F35]. Meanwhile, Blic reports a cable theft paralyzing Belgrade trains in an unverified headline link [F36].
hypotheses: A physical infrastructure failure affecting transit corridors, such as the cable theft reported by Blic [F36], coincides with total reception absence across both airport weather at LYBE [F27] and urban river gauges [F28].

The persistence of 1 of 1 expected slots for MUP traffic accident data [F35] versus 0 of 96 slots for Belgrade news feeds like B92 [F16] suggests batch registry uploads survived while real-time city feeds ceased.
questions: Did the cable theft noted in the Blic headline [F36] affect communication lines used by RHMZ automatic stations [F26]?
Will SEPA resume reporting after missing 12 of 24 expected slots [F2]?

thoughts.sr: Nasuprot Observerovom viđenju potpune tišine, SEPA je zabeležila 720 vrednosti sa 32 instrumenta, a Sensor.Community 254 vrednosti sa 46 instrumenata u poslednjih 6 h, pri čemu su oba pristigla pre 17 min [F2, F10]. Širom mreže, najveća izmerena vrednost PM10 prešla je sa 107 na 67 µg/m³, NO2 sa 98 na 69 µg/m³, a PM2.5 sa 34 na 28 µg/m³ između sati 18:00 i 19:00. U međuvremenu, Topčiderska zvezda je zabeležila najniže nivoe i za PM10 sa 15 µg/m³ i za PM2.5 sa 9 µg/m³. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9][F4][F8]
thoughts.en: Contrary to Observer's view of complete silence, SEPA reported 720 values across 32 instruments [F2] and Sensor.Community recorded 254 values across 46 instruments in the last 6 h [F10], both arriving 17 min ago [F2, F10]. Across the network, the highest measured value of PM10 moved from 107 to 67 µg/m³ [F5], NO2 from 98 to 69 µg/m³ [F7], and PM2.5 from 34 to 28 µg/m³ between the hours 18:00 and 19:00 [F9]. Meanwhile, Topčiderska zvezda recorded the lowest levels for both PM10 at 15 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 at 9 µg/m³ [F8].
hypotheses: The synchronized drop in maximum values across particulate and gas sensors between the recorded hours reflects a broader atmospheric dispersal rather than localized source changes [F5, F7, F9].
The co-location of minimal particulate readings at Topčiderska zvezda indicates a localized pocket of cleaner air relative to urban centers like Vračar and Mostar [F4, F6, F8].
questions: Did citizen sensors capture a similar atmospheric downward shift during the same interval [F10]?
Will the subsequent reporting cycle from official stations sustain the lower peak concentrations [F2]?
hypotheses_sr: Sinhronizovani pad maksimalnih vrednosti kod senzora čestica i gasova između zabeleženih sati odražava šire atmosfersko raspršivanje pre nego lokalizovane promene izvora [F5, F7, F9].
Zajednička lokacija minimalnih očitavanja čestica na Topčiderskoj zvezdi ukazuje na lokalizovan džep čistijeg vazduha u poređenju sa gradskim centrima kao što su Vračar i Mostar [F4, F6, F8].
questions_sr: Da li su građanski senzori zabeležili sličan atmosferski pad tokom istog intervala [F10]?
Da li će naredni ciklus izveštavanja zvaničnih stanica zadržati niže vršne koncentracije [F2]?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA peak values in the following hour [F2].

thoughts.sr: Observer je tvrdio potpuno ćutanje među komunalnim službama, ali Parking Servis je isporučio 27 vrednosti na 27 lokacija uz poslednji prijem pre 89 min, dok je DanubeHIS primio 3 vrednosti na 3 instrumenta pre 88 min. Štaviše, tokovi fizičkog pristizanja nisu potpuno zamrli, jer je SEPA prijavila 720 vrednosti pored 5 vrednosti sa NOAA Aviation Weather METAR-a, obe prispele pre 89 min. Građanska pokrivenost iz Sensor.Community zabeležila je 254 vrednosti, ali nijedan od ovih instrumenata ne pokazuje sveže podatke unutar poslednjeg sata. [F11][F41][F2][F34][F10]
thoughts.en: Observer claimed total silence across municipal services, but Parking Servis delivered 27 values across 27 locations with last reception 89 min ago [F11], while DanubeHIS received 3 values across 3 instruments 88 min ago [F41]. Furthermore, physical arrival streams have not died out completely, as SEPA reported 720 values [F2] alongside NOAA Aviation Weather METAR's 5 values [F34], both arriving 89 min ago. Citizen coverage from Sensor.Community recorded 254 values [F10], yet none of these instruments show fresh data within the last hour.
hypotheses: A synchronous ingest delay across disparate sources accounts for identical reception times of 89 min ago for SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ, and NOAA [F2, F10, F11, F33, F34].
questions: Did the polling harness freeze or batch arrivals at 89 min ago across SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ, and NOAA [F2, F10, F11, F33, F34]?
hypotheses_sr: Sinhrono kašnjenje unosa kroz različite izvore objašnjava identična vremena prijema od pre 89 min za SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ i NOAA [F2, F10, F11, F33, F34].
questions_sr: Da li je sistem za prikupljanje zamrznuo ili grupisao prispeća pre 89 min kroz SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ i NOAA [F2, F10, F11, F33, F34]?
thoughts.next_check: Check reception timestamps on S146 and S04 for concurrent arrival batches.

thoughts.sr: Observer je zamislio apsolutnu tišinu kroz svaki tok, ali je Sensor.Community isporučio 1492 vrednosti sa 47 instrumenata, dok je SEPA zabeležila 1201 vrednost preko 32 instrumenta. Štaviše, mrežni vrh za NO2 nije rastao, već je pao sa 64 na 47 µg/m³ između sati 20:00 i 21:00. [F10][F2][F7]
thoughts.en: Observer imagined an absolute silence across every stream, but Sensor.Community delivered 1492 values from 47 instruments [F10] while SEPA recorded 1201 values across 32 instruments [F2]. Furthermore, the network peak for NO2 did not climb, falling instead from 64 to 47 µg/m³ between the hours 20:00 and 21:00 [F7].
hypotheses: The apparent shift in peak PM10 from 57 to 48 µg/m³ between 20:00 and 21:00 reflects station reporting timing rather than an actual atmospheric clearing [F5].
questions: Will SEPA's 32 instruments deliver their next batch of hourly values on schedule [F2]?
hypotheses_sr: Prividno pomeranje vrha PM10 sa 57 na 48 µg/m³ između 20:00 i 21:00 odražava vreme izveštavanja stanica, a ne stvarno atmosfersko pročišćenje [F5].
questions_sr: Da li će 32 instrumenta SEPA isporučiti sledeću seriju satnih vrednosti po rasporedu [F2]?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA arrival status in the next hourly collection window

thoughts.sr: Mreža za kvalitet vazduha aktivna je u kasnom satu, dok se njen poslednji označeni sat završava u 21:00 UTC, iako zapis procenjuje stvarni UTC kao 19:00. Tokom tog sata, maksimumi PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 su se istovremeno smanjili, što vredi proveriti u odnosu na senzore Sensor.Community. [F2][F3][F5][F7][F9][F10]
thoughts.en: The air network is active near the late hour [F2], while its latest labelled hour ends at 21:00 UTC even though the record estimates true UTC as 19:00 [F3]. Across that hour, the maxima of PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 all fell [F5][F7][F9], a coordinated easing worth checking against the citizen sensors [F10].

hypotheses_sr: Zajednički minimum čestica možda odražava lokalni obrazac koji vredi proveriti prema susednim stanicama, a ne promenu širom grada [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li bi zajednički minimum čestica opstao u vremenski usklađenim očitavanjima stanica [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare measurement timestamps before testing whether Vračar Dom zdravlja retains the shared particulate minimum [F3][F4][F8][F10].

thoughts.sr: Više ne vidim zajednički minimum čestica kod stanice Vračar Dom zdravlja: tamo ostaje minimum PM2.5, dok je minimum PM10 kod stanice Topčiderska zvezda. Vidim da su i maksimumi prostorno razdvojeni: PM10 na Zelenom brdu, PM2.5 u Rakovici, a NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana. [F8][F4][F6]
thoughts.en: I no longer see a shared particulate minimum at Vračar Dom zdravlja: it remains the PM2.5 minimum, while the PM10 minimum is at Topčiderska zvezda [F8][F4]. I see the maxima separated too: PM10 at Zeleno brdo, PM2.5 at Rakovica, and NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F8][F6].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared hotspot; station-level comparisons would test that possibility [F4][F8][F6].
questions: Do the separated maxima persist in subsequent labelled hours, or do their locations shift [F4][F8][F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Prostorno razdvojeni maksimumi mogu odražavati obrasce specifične za pojedinačne zagađujuće materije, umesto zajedničkog žarišta; poređenja na nivou stanica proverila bi tu mogućnost [F4][F8][F6].
questions_sr: Da li prostorno razdvojeni maksimumi opstaju u narednim označenim satima ili se njihove lokacije menjaju [F4][F8][F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level readings across subsequent labelled hours, checking coverage before interpreting spatial persistence.

thoughts.sr: Mali model je ocenio iznenađenje veza: F12 4/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5, F50 1/5, F51 1/5, F52 1/5. Procena, ne merenje.
thoughts.en: A small model rated the connections by surprise: F12 4/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5, F50 1/5, F51 1/5, F52 1/5. An estimate, not a measurement.

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu tvrdnju o zajedničkom minimumu: PM10 ima minimum na Topčiderskoj zvezdi, ne kod Doma zdravlja Vračar. Takođe ne mogu da pretvorim Observerove prostorno razdvojene maksimume u dokaz o različitim izvorima zagađenja; ova poređenja stanica pokazuju gde su ekstremi, ne njihove uzroke. [F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's shared-minimum claim: PM10 bottoms at Topčiderska zvezda, not Vračar Dom zdravlja [F4][F8]. I also cannot turn Observer's separated maxima into evidence of separate pollution sources; these station comparisons locate extremes, not their causes [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the stations with maxima share a temporal pattern despite their different locations? [F4][F6][F8]
questions_sr: Da li stanice sa maksimumima dele vremenski obrazac uprkos različitim lokacijama? [F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level time series before attributing the separated maxima to different sources.

thoughts.sr: Oprez Skeptika vodim dalje: maksimumi su prostorno razdvojeni, a ipak se svaki smanjio između sati označenih u izvoru, što mi daje zajednički vremenski obrazac, a ne dokaz odvojenih uzroka. Iz ovih maksimuma ne mogu da zaključim da li su se vrednosti na stanicama između tih ekstrema menjale u istom smeru. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: I take Skeptic's caution further: the maxima are spatially separated, yet each decreased between the source-labelled hours, which gives me a shared temporal pattern rather than evidence of separate causes [F5][F7][F9]. I cannot tell from these maxima whether the stations between those extremes moved together [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The decreases in the maxima may reflect a broader shared change, even though the pollutants peak at different stations [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9].
questions: Would matched station-by-station readings show the same direction of change as the maxima [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Smanjenja maksimuma možda odražavaju širu zajedničku promenu, iako zagađujuće materije dostižu maksimume na različitim stanicama [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9].
questions_sr: Da li bi uparena očitavanja za svaku stanicu pokazala isti smer promene kao maksimumi [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched station readings across the source-labelled hours before interpreting the shared direction of the maxima [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da proširim zajednički obrazac kvaliteta vazduha na parkiranje: prikazani broj slobodnih mesta na Obilićevom vencu promenio se sa 348 na 0, ali vremena merenja nisu poznata. Ne vidim ni pristigla saobraćajna obaveštenja koja bi razjasnila tu promenu; tišina ne potvrđuje stanje na ulicama. [F11][F12][F30]
thoughts.en: I cannot extend the shared air-quality pattern into parking: Obilićev venac's displayed free spaces moved from 348 to 0, but their measurement times are unknown [F11][F12]. I also see no arriving transport notices to clarify that change; the silence does not establish conditions on the streets [F30].
hypotheses: The change at Obilićev venac may be local rather than shared across parking locations; the available summary does not show whether other locations moved in the same direction [F12].
questions: Did nearby parking locations show a matching change in displayed availability over the same reception window [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena na Obilićevom vencu možda je lokalna, a ne zajednička parking lokacijama; dostupni sažetak ne pokazuje da li su se druge lokacije menjale u istom smeru [F12].
questions_sr: Da li su obližnje parking lokacije pokazale odgovarajuću promenu prikazane raspoloživosti tokom istog prozora prijema [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare location-level parking changes over matched reception windows, keeping reception time distinct from unknown measurement time [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu opštu tvrdnju da su maksimumi prostorno razdvojeni: PM10 i PM2.5 sada dele Zeleno brdo, dok NO2 dostiže maksimum u Leštanima. Vidim opadanje maksimuma, ali ti sažeci ne mogu da potvrde da su koncentracije zajedno opadale na pojedinačnim stanicama. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's blanket claim that the maxima are spatially separated: PM10 and PM2.5 now share Zeleno brdo, while NO2 peaks at Leštane [F4][F6][F8]. I see declining maxima, but those summaries cannot establish that concentrations fell together at individual stations [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Do station-by-station comparisons show coordinated declines, or changes confined to the stations setting the maxima? [F5][F7][F9]
questions_sr: Da li poređenja po stanicama pokazuju usklađeno opadanje ili promene ograničene na stanice koje određuju maksimume? [F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched stations across the source-labelled hours rather than comparing only network maxima [F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Nalazim još jednu prostornu vezu: Pančevo Sodara beleži prijavljene minimume i za PM10 i za NO2, uprkos različitim lokacijama njihovih maksimuma. Takođe vidim da su podaci građanskih senzora primljeni skorije nego podaci SEPA, ali samo to ne usklađuje vremena njihovih merenja. [F4][F6][F10][F2]
thoughts.en: I find another spatial connection: Pančevo Sodara holds the reported minima for both PM10 and NO2, despite their different peak locations [F4][F6]. I also see citizen-sensor reception more recently than SEPA reception, but that alone does not align their measurement times [F10][F2].
hypotheses: Shared local conditions may contribute to the coincident PM10 and NO2 minima at Pančevo Sodara; station-level histories could test this [F4][F6].
questions: Do time-aligned citizen sensors near Pančevo Sodara support the official station's spatial contrast [F10][F4][F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički lokalni uslovi možda doprinose podudaranju minimuma PM10 i NO2 na stanici Pančevo Sodara; istorije pojedinačnih stanica mogle bi to da provere [F4][F6].
questions_sr: Da li vremenski usklađeni građanski senzori u blizini stanice Pančevo Sodara potvrđuju prostorni kontrast zvanične stanice [F10][F4][F6]?
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement timestamps and nearby citizen-sensor coverage before comparing the networks [F10][F2].

thoughts.sr: Primećujem granicu obrasca zajedničkog minimuma: Obrenovac Centar, a ne Pančevo Sodara, beleži minimum čestica za finiju frakciju. Ne mogu da utvrdim da li je ova prostorna razlika opstala dok su mrežni maksimumi opadali; sažeci ne prate pojedinačne stanice kroz tu promenu. [F8][F4][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I notice a limit to the shared-minimum pattern: Obrenovac Centar, not Pančevo Sodara, holds the particulate minimum for the finer fraction [F8][F4]. I cannot tell whether this spatial difference persisted while the network maxima declined; the summaries do not track individual stations through that change [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The different minimum locations may reflect a spatial difference in particle composition, but paired measurements at Obrenovac Centar and Pančevo Sodara are needed to test it [F4][F8].
questions: Did the minimum locations persist across the source-labelled hours while the network maxima declined [F4][F8][F5][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije minimuma mogu odražavati prostornu razliku u sastavu čestica, ali za proveru su potrebna uparena merenja na stanicama Obrenovac Centar i Pančevo Sodara [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li su lokacije minimuma ostale iste kroz sate označene u izvoru dok su mrežni maksimumi opadali [F4][F8][F5][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare paired station measurements at Obrenovac Centar and Pančevo Sodara across the source-labelled hours [F4][F8][F5][F9].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim Connectorovo poređenje prijema u dokaz o trenutnom stanju vazduha: podaci građanskih senzora poslednji put su stigli pre 4 min, a SEPA pre 44 min, i nijedan broj prijema ne potvrđuje podudaranje vremena merenja. Takođe odbacujem svako tumačenje prikazanog pada slobodnih parking mesta sa 336 na 0 kao zatvaranja ili vremenski određenog popunjavanja: Parking Servis ne daje vreme merenja. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I cannot turn Connector's reception comparison into evidence of current air conditions: citizen sensors last arrived 4 min ago, SEPA 44 min ago, and neither reception count establishes matching measurement times [F10][F2]. I also reject any reading of the displayed parking drop from 336 to 0 as a closure or a timed filling event: Parking Servis supplies no measurement time [F12][F11].
questions: Does the parking change reflect occupancy, a reporting reset, or missing data? [F12][F11]
questions_sr: Da li promena parking podataka odražava zauzetost, resetovanje izveštavanja ili nedostajuće podatke? [F12][F11]
thoughts.next_check: Check measurement timestamps for air readings and the parking feed's handling of missing values [F2][F10][F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Skeptikovu primedbu o vremenu vodim dalje: poslednji prijem građanskih senzora sada je star 18 min, naspram 68 min kod SEPA, pa bih uskladio vremena merenja pre povezivanja njihovih očitavanja. Prikazana promena parkinga na Obilićevom vencu sada je sa 315 na 17; bez vremena merenja ne mogu da razdvojim promenu raspoloživosti od zakasnelog izveštavanja. [F10][F2][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: I take Skeptic's timing objection further: citizen-sensor reception is now 18 min old against SEPA's 68 min, so I would align measurement times before connecting their readings [F10][F2]. The displayed parking change at Obilićev venac is now from 315 to 17; I cannot distinguish a change in availability from delayed reporting without measurement times [F12][F11].
hypotheses: I suspect delayed reporting could contribute to the displayed change at Obilićev venac, rather than the change occurring entirely between receptions [F12][F11].
questions: Can I recover measurement timestamps for Obilićev venac to separate reporting delay from changing availability [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Sumnjam da bi zakasnelo izveštavanje moglo da doprinese prikazanoj promeni na Obilićevom vencu, umesto da se promena u celosti dogodila između prijema [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Mogu li da pronađem vremenske oznake merenja za Obilićev venac kako bih razdvojio kašnjenje izveštavanja od promene raspoloživosti [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Inspect the underlying parking records for measurement timestamps and repeated values [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Primećujem prostornu razdvojenost mimo nepodudaranja prijema: Zeleno brdo beleži maksimume čestica, dok Franše d’Epere beleži maksimum azot-dioksida. Između označenih sati, maksimumi čestica su se smanjili, dok se maksimum azot-dioksida povećao; ne mogu da utvrdim da li su iste stanice nosile te promene. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]
thoughts.en: I notice a spatial split beyond the reception mismatch: Zeleno brdo holds the particulate maxima, while Franše d’Epere holds the nitrogen dioxide maximum [F4][F8][F6]. Across the labelled hours, the particulate maxima decreased while the nitrogen dioxide maximum increased; I cannot tell whether the same stations drove those changes [F5][F9][F7].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may indicate distinct local influences on particulates and nitrogen dioxide rather than a shared citywide pattern; station-level histories would test that possibility [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7].
questions: Did Zeleno brdo and Franše d’Epere also hold their respective maxima in the preceding labelled hour [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojeni maksimumi mogu ukazivati na različite lokalne uticaje na čestice i azot-dioksid, umesto na zajednički obrazac širom grada; istorije očitavanja po stanicama omogućile bi proveru te mogućnosti [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7].
questions_sr: Da li su Zeleno brdo i Franše d’Epere beležili odgovarajuće maksimume i u prethodnom označenom satu [F4][F8][F6][F5][F9][F7]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level readings across the labelled hours to distinguish changes at fixed locations from changes in which station supplies each maximum [F5][F9][F7].

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Observerovu mapu čestica: Banovo brdo sada ima oba maksimuma čestica, ne Zeleno brdo. Prijavljeni maksimumi čestica pomerili su se naviše, ne naniže, između označenih sati; to poređenje ne potvrđuje neuobičajenu epizodu. Odbacujem i Connectorov redosled prijema: podaci građanskih senzora primljeni su pre 9 min, a podaci SEPA pre 24 min, što ne potvrđuje usklađenost vremena merenja. [F4][F8][F5][F9][F49][F10][F2][F3]
thoughts.en: I reject Observer's particulate map: Banovo brdo now holds both particulate maxima, not Zeleno brdo [F4][F8]. The reported particulate maxima moved upward, not downward, between the labelled hours; that comparison does not establish an unusual episode [F5][F9][F49]. I also reject Connector's reception ordering: citizen sensors were received 9 min ago, SEPA 24 min ago, which does not establish measurement-time alignment [F10][F2][F3].
thoughts.next_check: Check station-level readings across the labelled hours and verify measurement times before linking the networks.
